attributes.description:
Find a daily eating rhythm that fits your life.

Kvil follows your schedule automatically. A quiet timer shows when your next eating window opens. When it opens, the countdown steps aside. There is nothing to start or stop.

MAKE THE WEEK YOUR OWN
Choose a separate eating window for every weekday, including overnight windows. Adjust today without changing the rest of your week.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Choose an opening reminder, a closing reminder, or both. Reminders are scheduled about four weeks ahead and renewed when Kvil runs. Open the app occasionally to keep them going.

A SMALL SPACE TO REFLECT
After your eating window closes, an optional check-in asks how the day felt. A simple weekly recap brings your answers together without scores or streaks.

WEIGHT, IF YOU WANT IT
Log measurements and view a recent trend. Optionally read weight from Apple Health and save new Kvil measurements to Health. There are no required weight targets.

AT A GLANCE
Use Kvil on Apple Watch, your Home Screen, and your Lock Screen. The Watch keeps your latest schedule so its timer works when your phone is unavailable.

QUIET BY DESIGN
Quiet forest photography, warm ivory days, and deep green nights. All artwork and device integrations are included for free.

YOUR DATA
No Kvil account. Schedule settings can sync through your iCloud account. Reflections stay on your device with free backup export and restore. Weight shared with Apple Health follows your Health settings. No ads or third-party tracking.

ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE
Your latest seven days of reflection history and a basic weekly recap are free. A single purchase unlocks older reflections and longer recaps. Your timer, schedules, reminders, artwork, weight logging, Apple Health, Watch, and widgets stay free.

Requires iOS 27 or later. Apple Watch requires watchOS 27 or later. Kvil is a planning tool for adults and does not provide medical advice.

Support: hjalmar@hkarlsen06.dev
attributes.promotionalText: A flexible daily eating schedule, gentle reminders, and space to reflect. Beautiful on iPhone, Apple Watch, and your widgets.
